description:
[writes · `ads:spend` scope] Sets the brand's monthly and/or per-campaign activation caps, in cents (e.g. 50000 = $500). Inside the owner's agent ceiling it is applied at once; above it the result is `approval_requested`: tell the user the owner has an approval request in Ads > Agent activity, and repeat the same call once they approve. Pass agentName and reason; both are shown to the owner.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/caps.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

monthlyMaxMinor.description: Monthly activation cap, whole cents (100 to 10000000).

perCampaignMaxMinor.description: Per-campaign activation cap, whole cents (100 to 10000000).

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_caps_set
title: Set ad spend caps
